data.name: Saboor
data.long_meaning: Saboor is an Arabic name that means patient, steadfast, and persevering. It is derived from the word صَبور (sabur), which means patient and steadfast.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being patient and steadfast is a virtue that is highly valued in Islam. Saboor is a name that embodies this virtue and encourages its bearer to be patient, steadfast, and persevering in all aspects of life.
data.numerology_meaning: A name of balance and harmony, indicating a person who is in tune with their environment and has a strong sense of inner peace

in_arabic.name: صبور
in_arabic.meaning: الصبر و التحمل في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم صبور مشتق من جذر ص-ب-ر، يعني الشخص الذي يتحمل و يصبر على الشدائد و الأمور الصعبة، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و هو اسم ذو معنى جميل و رفيع في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: صبور
in_urdu.meaning: صبر کرنے والا، تحمل کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: صبور نام کی اصطلاح عربی زبان کی ص-ب-ر جڑ سے نکلی ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے صبر کرنا، برداشت کرنا، اور مصائب و مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں اس کا بڑا دینی اور ثقافتی اثر ہے

in_hindi.name: सबूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: सबूर नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा के मूल ص-ب-ر से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है धैर्य करना, सहन करना, और कठिनाइयों का सामना करना, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, और इसकी गहरी आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक जड़ें हैं

in_pashto.name: صبور
in_pashto.meaning: د صبر کولو والا، د برداشت کولو والا
in_pashto.long_meaning: صبور نوم د عربي ژبې د ص-ب-ر ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د صبر کولو، د برداشت کولو، او د مشکلاتو د منلو څخه عبارت دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو او اسلامي ميراث کې ډیر اهم دی

in_english.name: Saboor
in_english.meaning: Patient, Enduring, One who bears with fortitude
in_english.long_meaning: The name Saboor originates from the Arabic root ص-ب-ر (ṣ-b-r), which conveys the meanings of patience, endurance, and fortitude. This name is mentioned in the Quran and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes the ability to withstand hardships and difficulties with perseverance and steadfastness. Across Muslim cultures, the name Saboor is associated with positive personality traits such as patience, resilience, and determination.

data.cultural_impact: The name Saboor carries cultural significance in various Islamic communities as a marker of resilience and unwavering determination. In a world where challenges are inevitable, the name Saboor is often seen as a reminder to be patient, steadfast, and persevere through difficult times. Furthermore, the name highlights the importance of sabr (patience), a key virtue in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Saboor holds deep significance as Sabr (patience) is one of the fundamental virtues in Islam. Sabr is considered a means of achieving nearness to Allah, and those who practice sabr are rewarded with peace, blessings, and divine blessings. The name Saboor serves as a constant reminder to its bearer of the importance of maintaining patience and steadfastness in times of hardship, and striving for spiritual growth through the practice of sabr.
